categories.title: Ice Breakers
categories.description: Fun and light questions to get started.
questions: What’s your favorite way to spend a weekend?
If you could have any superpower, what would it be?
What is your favorite food?
Do you prefer cats or dogs?
What was the last movie you watched?

categories.title: Daily Life
categories.description: Talk about your routines and habits.
questions: What is your morning routine like?
How do you usually get to work or school?
What do you like to do after a long day?
What is your favorite season and why?
Do you like cooking? What is your best dish?

categories.title: Travel
questions: What is the best place you have ever visited?
Where do you want to go for your next vacation?
Do you prefer beach vacations or city trips?
Have you ever traveled alone?
What is the most important thing you pack for a trip?

categories.title: Deep & Abstract
questions: What is one value that is most important to you?
If you could change one thing about the world, what would it be?
What does 'success' mean to you?
Do you believe that money can buy happiness?
What is a lesson you learned the hard way?

categories.title: Business & Career
questions: What is your dream job?
What is the biggest challenge you face at work?
Do you prefer working alone or in a team?
How do you handle stress at work?
Where do you see yourself in 5 years?

categories.title: Tech & Future
questions: What is your favorite gadget?
Do you think AI will replace human jobs?
How much time do you spend on social media?
What technology are you most excited about?
Do you prefer reading physical books or e-books?
